scope: CC-137 fixed-checkpoint model and reasoning-effort experiment

frozen_decision_protocol.decision: Report the accuracy leader. For a faster trial configuration require the paired lower accuracy bound to remain within two points of that leader. Within the eligible set prefer lower continuation p95, then lower estimated cost.
frozen_decision_protocol.fact_rule: Frozen necessary conditions plus exact required estimates and MOEs
frozen_decision_protocol.latency: Common SDK, HTTP, Census and local timing attribution in the same run
frozen_decision_protocol.order: Six-position balanced order with 15 observations per arm in every position
frozen_decision_protocol.primary: Verified required facts on the 21 exactly scorable families, 63 trials per arm
frozen_decision_protocol.secondary: V6 structural accuracy over all 90 planned trials per arm
